$comment: Upstream reference sources this server can query. Each is FETCHED on demand into a
per-user cache directory — none of them is vendored into this repository and none is a
git submodule. The bundled language-feature example corpus formerly under examples/ has
moved to flatrick/dotnet-code-examples; it is not a source in this file today.
'pin' is the commit this repository vouches for. A caller may instead request the ref in
'head', which opts into upstream drift; every response states which of the two it came
from, because an answer whose version is unknown is worse than no answer.
'repository' is the stable owner/name identity carried in each provenance envelope.
'sparse' limits the checkout to the paths the query tools actually read. dotnet-api-docs
is large enough that a full clone is not a reasonable first-run experience.

csharplang.head: main
csharplang.purpose: C# language design: proposals, specification, LDM notes, version history.

vblang.head: main
vblang.purpose: VB.NET language design. Note its version history only covers VB 15.0 onward.

roslyn-api-docs.head: main
roslyn-api-docs.purpose: Roslyn compiler and workspace API XML docs (Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.*), plus the MSBuild types MSBuildWorkspace exposes (Microsoft.Build.Framework).

roslyn-wiki.head: main
roslyn-wiki.purpose: Roslyn wiki pages: analyzer authoring, API changes, contributor docs.

nuget-docs.head: main
nuget-docs.purpose: NuGet package management: PackageReference, restore, packing, nuget.config, CLI and MSBuild reference, nuget.org.
